Charlotte Flair has had **18 WWE championship reigns**: 14 main-roster singles world-title reigns, two NXT Women’s Championship reigns, and two Women’s Tag Team Championship reigns. Here they are in chronological order, through September 27, 2026.[1][2][3]

## Every title reign

| # | Championship | Reign dates | Tag partner |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | NXT Women’s Championship | May 29, 2014 – February 11, 2015 | — |
| 2 | Divas Championship | September 20, 2015 – April 3, 2016 | — |
| 3 | WWE Women’s Championship, later called the Raw Women’s Championship | April 3 – July 25, 2016 | — |
| 4 | Raw Women’s Championship | August 21 – October 3, 2016 | — |
| 5 | Raw Women’s Championship | October 30 – November 28, 2016 | — |
| 6 | Raw Women’s Championship | December 18, 2016 – February 13, 2017 | — |
| 7 | SmackDown Women’s Championship | November 14, 2017 – April 10, 2018 | — |
| 8 | SmackDown Women’s Championship | August 19 – September 16, 2018 | — |
| 9 | SmackDown Women’s Championship | March 26 – April 7, 2019 | — |
| 10 | SmackDown Women’s Championship | May 19, 2019 — won and lost the same night | — |
| 11 | SmackDown Women’s Championship | October 6 – 11, 2019 | — |
| 12 | NXT Women’s Championship | April 5 – June 7, 2020 | — |
| 13 | WWE Women’s Tag Team Championship | December 20, 2020 – January 31, 2021 | Asuka |
| 14 | Raw Women’s Championship | July 18 – 19, 2021 | — |
| 15 | Raw Women’s Championship | August 21 – October 22, 2021 | — |
| 16 | SmackDown Women’s Championship | October 22, 2021 – May 8, 2022 | — |
| 17 | SmackDown Women’s Championship | December 30, 2022 – April 1, 2023 | — |
| 18 | WWE Women’s Tag Team Championship | August 2 – November 10, 2025 | Alexa Bliss |

The dates follow CAGEMATCH’s reign history, except that the second NXT reign is shown from **April 5, 2020**, when her WrestleMania 36 victory over Rhea Ripley aired; CAGEMATCH lists the earlier taping date, March 26.[2][4][5]

The often-quoted **14-time world champion** total counts her one Divas, six Raw/WWE Women’s, and seven SmackDown Women’s reigns. It does not include the two NXT or two tag-team reigns.[1][2]

Charlotte Flair has won the Raw Women’s Championship (originally created as the WWE Women’s Championship in 2016) **six** times. She holds the all-time record for the most reigns with this specific title.[1][2]

## Raw Championship Reigns

- **1st reign:** April 3, 2016 – July 25, 2016 (won at WrestleMania 32 as the inaugural champion)[3][1]
- **2nd reign:** August 21, 2016 – October 3, 2016 (won at SummerSlam)[4][3]
- **3rd reign:** October 30, 2016 – November 28, 2016 (won at Hell in a Cell)[5][3]
- **4th reign:** December 18, 2016 – February 13, 2017 (won at Roadblock: End of the Line)[6][3]
- **5th reign:** July 18, 2021 – July 19, 2021 (won at Money in the Bank)[2]
- **6th reign:** August 21, 2021 – October 22, 2021 (won at SummerSlam)[2]

entries.query: not sasha hold the most time this title?
entries.answer:
No, Sasha Banks held the Raw Women's Championship **five** times, while Charlotte Flair broke her record by winning it **six** times.[1][2]

## The Rivalry Context

The confusion often arises because Sasha Banks set the record first. During their famous 2016 feud on *Monday Night Raw*, the title traded back and forth repeatedly:[3][4][5][1]

- Sasha won the belt on episodes of *Raw*.[4][6]
- Charlotte took it back at pay-per-view events (SummerSlam, Hell in a Cell, and Roadblock: End of the Line).[5][7]

In July 2020, Sasha won the Raw Women's Championship for a **fifth** time by defeating Asuka, which broke the tie with Charlotte and set a then-record.[2][1]

## Charlotte Overtaking the Record

Charlotte Flair surpassed Sasha's mark in 2021 by capturing the belt two more times:[8][2]

1. **5th reign:** Defeated Rhea Ripley at *Money in the Bank* in July 2021.[8]
2. **6th reign:** Defeated Rhea Ripley and Nikki A.S.H. in a triple-threat match at *SummerSlam* in August 2021.[8]

With that sixth victory, Charlotte took sole possession of the record for the **most** reigns with that championship.[9][2]

entries.query: mivan levette charlptte az ovet rhearol?
entries.answer:
Igen, Charlotte Flair nemcsak egyszer, hanem **kétszer** is elvette a bajnoki címet Rhea Ripley-től egyéni meccsen:

## 1. NXT Women's Championship (WrestleMania 36 – 2020)

- **A meccs:** 2020. április 5-én, a közönség nélkül rendezett WrestleMania 36-on csaptak össze. Charlotte a 2020-as női Royal Rumble megnyerése után kifejezetten Ripley NXT-címét választotta célpontként.
- **A végeredmény:** Egy nagyjából 20 perces küzdelem után Charlotte a védjegyévé vált *Figure-Eight Leglock* feladásos fogással kopogtatásra kényszerítette Rhea Ripley-t, megszerezve második NXT-bajnoki címét.

## 2. Raw Women's Championship (Money in the Bank – 2021)

- **A meccs:** 2021. július 18-án a Money in the Bank gálán találkoztak, ahol Ripley a Raw Women's övet tette kockára.
- **A végeredmény:** Charlotte ismét feladásra kényszerítette Ripley-t a lábkulccsal, ezzel véget vetett Rhea 98 napos uralkodásának, és megszerezte karrierje 5. Raw-bajnoki címét.

## A visszavágó: WrestleMania 39 (2023)

A kettejük rivalizálása 2023-ban ért fel a csúcsra a WrestleMania 39-en: ekkor fordult a kocka, és **Rhea Ripley** győzte le Charlotte-ot, megszerezve tőle a SmackDown Women's Championshipet az év egyik legelismertebb női WWE-mérkőzésén.
